description.value: Using simultaneous PET/MRI, we evaluated the diagnostic performance of ASL in identifying pathological abnormalities in FTD to determine whether ASL can provide similar diagnostic value as FDG-PET.

The study cohort included 10 neurologically healthy controls and 11 patients with FTD recruited from the Cognitive Neurology and Aging Brain clinics at Parkwood Hospital (London, ON) between January 2014 and October 2014.

A pseudo-continuous ASL (pCASL) sequence with a single-shot 3D gradient-and-spin-echo (3D GRASE) readout ( ) was acquired within 10 min of FDG injection using the following parameters: TR/TE = 3500/22.76 ms, post-labelling delay (PLD) = 1.5 s, 64 label and control pairs, 26 contiguous slices (23 acquired slices with 15.4% oversampling and 6/8 Partial Fourier in the slice-encoding direction; parallel imaging acceleration factor of 2 along the phase-encoding direction, with GRAPPA reconstruction, and refocusing flip angle of 180 degrees), bandwidth = 2004 Hz/pixel, and 3.8 × 3.8 × 6 mm 3 voxel size.
